rows.description: A teenager wants to pursue art or sport while the family expects engineering or medicine. Love and obligation pull against a personal dream, and open conversation beats secret rebellion or silent surrender.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Parent facing the child's different values [Receiver]
rows.description: A parent sees a child choose beliefs, career or lifestyle they did not expect and feels fear, grief and pride. Listening to the reasons before responding keeps the relationship intact.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: grief, fear, pride

rows.description: A young adult wants to choose a partner, career or city that differs from family custom. Feels both gratitude and frustration, and seeks a path that honours roots without giving up their own life.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A graduate weighs a stable government or corporate job against a risky start-up or creative path. Fear of losing security fights with fear of a life unlived, and small experiments can test the choice.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtype: Observing a friend caught between worlds [Observer]
rows.description: A friend notices someone juggling family expectations and personal goals who seems tired and evasive. Being a listener without pushing either side gives them space to think clearly.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtype: Loyalty to family versus honesty with self [Actor]
rows.description: A young adult repays family expectations, sends money home and delays their own wants, while feeling resentment and guilt. Loving and resenting at once is human, and clear talk about limits helps.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A wise person names each value, asks what each protects, and looks for a choice or sequence that honours both as far as possible. Accepts that some loss comes with any choice, and decides without pretending otherwise.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A teenager sets clear goals, tracks results and feels restless without a target. Drive brings progress, but success can become the only measure of worth if rest and relationships are neglected.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A young adult cares about getting truly good at a craft more than status or titles. Goals are private and steady, and may be misread by others as lack of drive.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A student chases ranks, brands and titles to impress family or peers and feels hollow after reaching them. Reflection on whose approval is being chased helps redirect ambition toward what matters.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 23–26
